resources.string: Run sends requests to ipify, ipwho.is, Cloudflare, Google (including STUN) and the sites listed below. They can see the exit used for their request.
VPN indicates the transport type; IPv4 and IPv6 indicate local addresses. These settings do not prove which resolver or proxy a request used.
One HTTPS download from Cloudflare via this app’s route. Includes connection time; not peak line speed.
To response headers: %1$d ms · Read body: %2$d ms
Three HTTPS 204 requests per site. With three samples P95 is the slowest success; jitter is the mean change between adjacent successful requests. A failed request is not a lost packet.
Run the check while connected to see which exit the test sites observe.
HTTPS checks follow this app’s routing rules, which may select direct connections. A site’s response does not prove that content or an account is unlocked.
